name: Katlit
source: The leader of the dragon tribe that lives in the "Cloud Sea of Raifu" in the Kingdom of Influs. She is young among the dragon tribe, which makes it difficult for her to exude dignity. As a result, she relies on those around her to lead the village and fulfill her duties within the Fiushia Church. She feels indebted to her companions who helped her grow and often visits the fortress in the hope of providing assistance. She is timid and never asserts herself against others. Despite having a kind personality and a lack of desire to fight with others, she has started to try hard to express her opinions, perhaps because she has taken on a position of responsibility. Recently, she has been told many times to "find a husband quickly," which seems to be bothering her a little.
